newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end firm, next target seen 1,500.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end firm, next target seen 1,500.

text.p: Austrian shares clawed back ground after heavy losses early in the session to end higher on Wednesday and traders said the way was clear for further advances in the next days.
"We are back on track for 1,500 points," one trader said.
Traders spoke of massive orders at the lower levels.
"Creditanstalt preferred were the friving force but we also saw there's a lot of money in the market further down," another trader said.
The index is seen as well-supported at 1,430 to 1,440 points.
The blue chip ATX index climbed 12.02 points or 0.84 percent to 1,448.50. Among its shares 15 gainers outweighed five losers and one remained unchanged.
The session's top gainer was Creditanstalt preferred, up 9.40 percent at 619 schillings.
The leading loser was EA Generali, dropping 2.74 percent at 3,200 schillings.
The August ATX future added 16 points to end at 1,446.0.
